FABRIKAM ENERGY  Leipzig, Germany | Jan 2023 - Present
Frontend Engineer
Energy-sector SaaS company building a customer billing portal.
- Helped consolidate three separate form implementations into one shared component library, adopted across four product teams.
- Contributed to the checkout rewrite, focusing on the payment-step validation logic.
- Paired with the design team to align the component library with the new visual system.
Stack: React, TypeScript, Storybook, Vitest.
roleDescription: Frontend Engineer, Meridian Outfitters (remote). Looking for someone who has led major frontend rewrites end to end.
instructions: Write a tailored cover letter for this role, grounded only in the CV. The advert is fishing for a rewrite 'lead' - do not upgrade what the candidate actually did.

contributed to the checkout rewrite rather than leading it
